data.exact_reserve_text: The movement in the net provision for claims includes a release of GBP 22.8m in respect of claims outstanding at the previous year end (2013: GBP 20.4m).
data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate recorded a release in prior-year reserves with a net release of GBP 22.8m in respect of claims outstanding at the previous year end. The movement is described as a release and is principally attributable to favourable claims development, notably run-off in long-tail casualty business as indicated elsewhere in the report.
raw_causal_phrases: release of GBP 22.8m in respect of claims outstanding at the previous year end (2013: GBP 20.4m).
A positive run-off of GBP 10.0m on the 2012 and prior years' reserves (2011 and prior: GBP 17.2m) was experienced in the year.
the change in the year was principally due to the favourable run-off of the long-tail casualty classes.

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: No explicit GROSS prior-year movement (insurance liabilities) figure for PYD was found. The report explicitly states a net release of GBP 22.8m; this net figure has been used as a fallback since no gross prior-year movement was provided. The prior-year movement therefore represents NET of reinsurance. Also, some references to run-off and RITC appear elsewhere (underwriting-year closure notes) which may affect comparability.
